comparison.objective: Load a washer rack without obstructing its spray arm, then rotate the arm; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Collision-aware placement followed by articulated-arm rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Rack is loaded so the spray arm turns freely, and the arm is turned half a revolution; detailed thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Clearance-aware loading and rotation are unrelated to bimanual hammering and fracture-product containment.
